$comment: Documented, EXPIRING exceptions for scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Every advisory
still fails CI unless it is listed here by its GHSA id and unexpired.
An entry is a risk decision with a date on it, not a mute button: when
`expires` passes the gate goes red again so the decision gets remade.
Never add an entry to make a build green — add it only when there is no
upstream fix AND the exposure is understood and written down.

accepted.reason: Infinite-loop DoS in image-size's ICNS/JXL/HEIF parsers, reached via @molecule/api-export-pptx -> pptxgenjs 4.0.1. Re-checked 2026-09-14: image-size 2.0.3 is outside the advisory range (<=2.0.2), but pptxgenjs 4.0.1 — its LATEST — still declares image-size ^1.2.1 and uses the v1 default export, so neither a bump nor an overrides pin to 2.x resolves it without breaking pptxgenjs, and npm's suggested fix is still a three-major downgrade. MITIGATED BY REACHABILITY, not merely accepted: src/imageSafety.ts refuses those three formats at the package boundary before pptxgenjs is called, sniffing magic numbers for buffers and data URIs so a declared image/png cannot smuggle HEIF past it (covered by src/__tests__/imageSafety.test.ts). Residual risk: an src URL/path is checked by extension only, since the bytes are fetched inside pptxgenjs. Re-check at expiry for a pptxgenjs release that accepts image-size 2.

Prototype replacement in csv-parse when BOTH columns:true AND group_columns_by_name:true are set and a duplicated __proto__ header appears in the input (advisory published 2026-09-08T18:01Z — it went red mid-release). Reached only via @molecule/api-permissions-casbin -> casbin 5.51.1 -> csv-parse 5.6.0. NO upstream fix exists at or above the pinned versions: casbin 5.51.1 is the LATEST release and npm's fixAvailable is a DOWNGRADE to casbin 5.4.1; csv-parse is patched only in 7.0.2, and forcing csv-parse 7 under casbin is a blind major bump of an indirect. MITIGATED BY REACHABILITY: casbin invokes csv-parse/sync parse(line, {delimiter, skip_empty_lines, trim, relax_quotes}) with NEITHER vulnerable option set (verified in casbin 5.51.1 lib/cjs/persist/helper.js — it parses policy lines into token ARRAYS, never objects with column mapping), so the __proto__ setter branch cannot execute through this path. Residual risk: a future casbin release that adds column mapping would re-expose it — the gate goes red again at expiry. Re-checked 2026-09-23: casbin latest is still 5.51.1 and still declares csv-parse ^5.5.6, so no upstream fix; the patched csv-parse 7.0.2 could only be forced by a root `overrides`, which does not reach a consumer installing @molecule/api-permissions-casbin, so the reachability mitigation stands. Re-check for a casbin release accepting csv-parse 7 (or shipping the fix) at expiry, and drop this entry then.

RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature VERIFICATION accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements (advisory published 2026-10-01/02 — it went red mid-release on the version-packages commit). NO upstream fix exists: node-forge 1.4.0 is the LATEST published version and the advisory range is `*`; npm audit reports fixAvailable: false. node-forge is a direct dependency of @molecule/api-wallet-pass only, which uses it to SIGN Apple Wallet passes locally with developer-provided certificates — it never runs signature VERIFICATION on untrusted input, so the vulnerable code path (verification) is not reachable from the package's API surface. Residual risk: a future refactor that feeds untrusted signatures into node-forge would re-expose it; the gate goes red again at expiry so the decision gets remade. Re-check for a node-forge release (or a maintained fork) at expiry, and drop this entry then.

Stack-exhaustion DoS in braces when compiling a deeply-nested glob pattern (advisory published 2026-09-18T18:31Z — CI went red on it before the 2026-10-03 app-ide-react release). NO upstream fix exists: the advisory range is braces <= 3.0.3 with first_patched_version null — every released version is vulnerable, and npm audit reports the only remediation as a DOWNGRADE of @changesets/cli 2.31.1 to 2.25.2 (2022), which is arborist picking an older tree that happens to lack micromatch, not a patched chain. Dev-only by reachability: the chain lives entirely in the repo-root devDependencies that run versioning/docs tooling locally and in CI; the --omit=dev audit does not contain braces, micromatch, globby, fast-glob or any @changesets package, and no @molecule package declares any of them, so nothing shipped or scaffolded carries the code. The DoS also requires feeding a crafted nested glob to the matcher — here the patterns are our own workspace globs, not attacker input. Residual risk: a future tooling change that passes external input as a glob would re-expose it; the gate goes red again at expiry so the decision gets remade. Re-check at expiry for a patched braces release or a changesets/micromatch chain without it, bump, and drop this entry.

seroval (and solid-js, which depends on it) have two advisories: fromJSON() invoking plugin-produced callables, and memory exhaustion from an unchecked TypedArray length in JSON deserialization. Both are about DESERIALIZING UNTRUSTED seroval payloads. NO upstream fix reachable: the patched seroval is 1.6.3 or later, but solid-js 1.9.15, its LATEST release, still declares seroval ~1.5.4, and an override outside that range is not something solid-js is tested against. Exposure: solid-js and seroval are DEV dependencies of @molecule/app-frameworks-solid and @molecule/app-ui-solid (tests and type-checking only); the published packages declare solid-js as a peer, ship no seroval and never deserialize a seroval payload. Re-checked 2026-10-06. Re-check at expiry for a solid-js release that accepts seroval 1.6.
